name: CMSY+
outputs: Relative biomass, depletion, productivity proxies

name: BSM (CMSY+ with index)
outputs: Biomass, depletion, MSY reference points

name: JABBA
application: Catch + one or more indices (+ auxiliary)
outputs: Posterior biomass and F, MSY reference points, Kobe probabilities, projections

name: SPiCT
application: Catch + one or more indices (+ auxiliary)
outputs: Biomass and F, B/BMSY, F/FMSY, forecasts

name: YPR / SPR / Thompson & Bell
outputs: YPR, SPR, proxy reference points

name: LBSPR
outputs: SPR and proxy fishing status

name: LBB
outputs: B/B0, B/BMSY proxy, F/M, length indicators

name: FLicc
outputs: SPR, Fspr, EPR (B/B0), selectivity by gear, length-based indicators, MSE estimation model
app: Stock Monitoring Tool – FLicc module (prototype in development)

name: fishblicc
outputs: SPR, selectivity by gear, F/M

name: TropFishR (ELEFAN_GA + YPR/SBPR)
outputs: Growth parameters (Linf, K), Z and F from catch curve, YPR/SBPR reference points (F0.1, Fmax, F30–40%)

name: Statistical catch-at-length
outputs: Dynamic size-structured status

name: Age-structured models (XSA, SAM, a4a, SS3)
outputs: SSB, F, recruitment, reference points, forecasts
software: FLXSA, SAM, a4a, SS3; diagnostics: ss3diags, XSAdiags

name: mmsyFM
subclass: Multispecies MSY and mixed-fishery harvest strategies
application: Mixed fisheries: several stocks, métiers and fleet segments
state_space: Simulation (Schaefer stocks with JABBA-type process error)
error_structure: Process error; assessment and implementation error in closed loop
outputs: Safeguarded multispecies MSY (every stock ≥ Bpa), yield/revenue/profit curves, effort and closure rules tuned to risk, performance statistics and decision tables
app: mmsyFM Shiny app (run_app()); iMarine hosting under consideration

name: Length-based indicators (LBI)
outputs: Indicator ratios (e.g. Lc/Lmat, L25/Lmat, Lmean/Lopt, Lmaxy/Lopt, Lmean/LF=M) with traffic-light status

name: Exploitation history indicators
application: Catch history, fishery development and timeline of events
outputs: Development phase of the fishery (developing, fully exploited, declining, collapsed), catch relative to historical maximum, timing of expansion and decline
software: Spreadsheet or R; timeline template from FAO TP 706

name: Catch, CPUE and effort trend indicators
application: Time series of catch, CPUE, effort, fleet capacity
outputs: Direction and rate of change in catch, CPUE, effort and capacity; recent versus reference-period ratios
software: R or spreadsheet; JARA for trends with uncertainty

name: Multi-indicator dashboards (traffic light)
application: Several quantitative and qualitative indicators, including local knowledge
outputs: Traffic-light table combining indicators of abundance, size, exploitation and ecosystem state; decision rules for management responses

name: Productivity–susceptibility analysis (PSA)
application: Life history and fishery exposure, no time series needed
outputs: Relative vulnerability score by stock for prioritisation
software: Spreadsheet or R (e.g. NOAA PSA tools)

name: Data preparation workflow (FAO TP 706)
outputs: Data inventory, timeline of events, life-history inventory, cleaned data, coverage and EDA

name: cpueTargeting
application: Multispecies logbook or observer catch and effort
outputs: Standardised CPUE index with log SE and CV; diagnostics (influence, residuals, predictive checks); simulation tests of targeting

name: JARA
outputs: Joint index with uncertainty, population trend and decline rates

name: FishualizeR
outputs: QC plots, data-coverage metrics, length compositions binned by year, area or gear

name: FLRef
outputs: Reference points, stock status plots, advice tables, HCR summaries

name: FLR mse
outputs: Performance of HCRs against risk, yield and stability
